author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Expected to Earn Q1 2019 Earnings of $4.83 Per Share
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities research analysts at KeyCorp raised their Q1 2019 earnings per share estimates for shares of Apple in a research note issued to investors on Sunday, October 21st. KeyCorp analyst A. Hargreaves now expects that the iPhone maker will post earnings per share of $4.83 for the quarter, up from their prior estimate of $4.63. KeyCorp also issued estimates for Apple’s Q2 2019 earnings at $3.21 EPS, Q3 2019 earnings at $2.69 EPS, Q4 2019 earnings at $3.14 EPS and FY2019 earnings at $13.93 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Other research analysts have also issued research reports about the company. New Street Research lowered Apple from a “neutral” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Monday, August 20th. Bank of America boosted their price target on Apple from $250.00 to $256.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, September 10th. Morgan Stanley upped their price objective on Apple from $245.00 to $247.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a report on Thursday, September 13th. Macquarie set a $214.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 15th. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group restated a “neutral” rating and issued a $240.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, September 13th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have given a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the company. The stock has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $224.63.
Shares of AAPL opened at $220.65 on Tuesday. The firm has a market cap of $1,077.94 billion, a P/E ratio of 23.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.68 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple has a 12 month low of $150.24 and a 12 month high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 EPS.
